notes: 75-inch 4K interactive flat panel (Gen 5 ViewBoard). Ports and specs sourced from ViewSonic's own global datasheet and the manuals.viewsonic.com Full Guide/Connecting Devices pages. HDMI 1/2/3 are inputs (HDMI1 supports CEC/ARC); HDMI OUT is a separate mirror/loop-through output. USB Type A total is 6 (2x USB2.0 + 4x USB3.0); ports are unlabeled individually by number in the datasheet so a single representative USB-A entry is used with a note on the total count. TOUCH 1 and TOUCH 2 are USB Type-B "touch-back" ports that send touch data to an externally connected PC via HDMI1/2 and HDMI3 respectively - functionally bidirectional data ports, connector is USB-B. USB Type-C supports DP1.2 alt-mode video, USB2.0 data, 65W Power Delivery, and 100M Ethernet passthrough - graded here as usb-2.0 per its stated USB data spec (DP video alt-mode has no separate grade field available for combo ports). RJ45 LAN is 10/100/1000M (dual RJ45 ports). AC IN connector type (IEC C13/C14 vs other) is not explicitly stated on the pages retrieved; assumed standard IEC (C13/C14) inlet given the panel ships with a 3m detachable power cord - this is inferred, not directly confirmed, hence flagged. Internal OPS (Open Pluggable Specification) slot for an optional embedded PC module exists but is an internal card-bay, not an external cable port, so it is omitted from the port list. Also present but omitted as non-cabling controls: IR remote receiver, power switch, physical menu buttons, built-in WiFi module slot.
